entries.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
entries.summary: Three drawn positions of a dumbbell Romanian deadlift, seen from the side.

provenance.positions: Authored for this repository from its own curated execution instructions and coaching cues for movement_id 88 (packages/core-db/src/schema/017_movement_batch.sql, 025_movement_coaching_content.sql).
instructionAgreement: stand — "Stand with dumbbells resting on the front of your thighs."
hinge — "Push your hips straight back and let the dumbbells slide down your legs, knees softly bent"; the hips travel back while the knees stay softly bent.

bottom — dumbbells drawn at mid-shin with a flat back, the depth the instructions describe as "until the hamstrings tell you to stop"; the load stays against the legs, per "daylight between them and you means the load has wandered onto your back".
provenance.artwork: No third-party artwork. Every frame is a list of joint coordinates in this file, drawn at runtime from plain React Native views.
provenance.licence: Original work created for this repository; covered by the repository licence.

entries.reviewNotes: Side view only. Bottom depth varies with hamstring length; the drawn depth is one common range, not a target. No qualified technique reviewer has signed this off yet.
entries.limitations: Three frames cannot show the moment the back starts rounding, which is the real stopping signal in the instructions.

frames.caption: Stand tall with the dumbbells resting on the front of the thighs
Push the hips back; the dumbbells slide down to the knees, knees softly bent
Dumbbells at mid-shin, back flat and long, hamstrings loaded

frames.caption: Stand tall with the bar close to the thighs and a soft bend in the knees.
Send the hips back while the bar tracks down the legs.
The bar tracks down the legs until the hamstrings are loaded.
Drive the hips through to stand, keeping the bar close.

entries.name: Cable Deadlifts
entries.summary: Seven drawn positions of a cable deadlift, seen from the side.
entries.reason: Own drawn frames authored for this repository after owner review: a neutral upright start between the two low stacks (ruling 4), hips travelling on the exact thigh circle and the torso rotating on the exact spine so knees extend with the hips on the drive, arms long to the handles throughout, and the near cable running to a low pulley just ahead of the toes. The pulley position and the knee coupling are listed as open questions for the owner at the checkpoint. Draft preview pending qualified technique review.

frames.caption: Stand tall between the stacks, a handle in each hand, cables just off the stack.
Brace before the cables leave the stack.
Sit the hips back and take the handles with long arms.
Handles near the shins; the hamstrings carry the load.
Push the floor away; extend the hips and knees together.
Handles finish beside the thighs, tall and braced.
Stand tall again; ready for the next rep.

entries.name: Stiff Leg Barbell Good Morning
techniqueCitations: Haff, G. G., & Triplett, N. T. (Eds.). (2016). Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning (4th ed.). Human Kinetics.
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, because the earlier drawing was against this text: the knees bent a good deal and the torso stopped well short of level. Source-bound side-view draft: the bar lies across the back of the shoulders with the hands on it; the hips travel back and the straight trunk lowers until it is about level with the floor, then the hips come forward to stand tall. The knees keep the one soft bend they start with for the whole rep, so the legs only lean back with the hips. The bar is seen end-on. Not drawn: the rack, and the shoulder-width stance, which a side view cannot show.
entries.summary: With the bar across the back of the shoulders and the legs still, push the hips back and lower a straight torso to about level with the floor, then bring the hips forward to stand tall.

frames.caption: Take the bar from the rack across the back of the shoulders and stand with the feet shoulder-width apart, back straight and head up.
Keeping the legs still, push the hips back and lower the torso until it is about level with the floor.
Back straight, ribs down.
Bring the hips forward to stand tall again.
Hips back, legs still. Stand tall through the hips.

frames.caption: Hike the bell close between the legs with a long flat back.
Snap the hips to stand tall and let the bell rise.
The bell leaves the legs behind as the hips finish.
Arms stay long while the bell swings up.
The bell floats at chest height with quiet, long arms.
Guide the bell back down as the hips reload.
The bell returns along the same arc.
The hinge reloads to meet the bell.
Hike the bell back between the legs for the next rep.

entries.name: Band Good Morning
techniqueCitations: Video: Band Good Morning technique demonstration (YouTube, video ID CTRaCzE8pWU).
entries.reason: Own drawn frames authored for this repository: a side-view hip hinge with a long band under the mid-foot and across the back of the shoulders, held at the front with elbows soft. The band runs behind the knee and up the back; it visibly stretches through the drive. The hips travel on the exact thigh circle and the torso rotates on the exact spine, with the neck constant, so every drawn bone keeps its length. Draft preview pending qualified technique review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a band good morning, seen from the side.

frames.caption: Stand tall with the band across your shoulders, clear of the neck.
Brace first, then send the hips back.
Hinge until the hamstrings load; keep the band over mid-foot.
Drive the floor away and squeeze the glutes.
Finish tall through the glutes.

entries.name: Power Clean
entries.reason: An Olympic-derived lift. Pull, triple extension, turnover and catch cannot be depicted honestly in about three frames, and a coarse drawing of a fast lift invites imitation of the wrong shape.

entries.name: Deadlift
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 24 degrees so the bar over mid-foot, the shins brought to the bar, the braced trunk, and the secure grip outside the legs all read clearly: setting up with the plates on the floor, pulling the slack out and pushing the floor away to stand tall with the bar close to the legs, and returning the bar to the floor over mid-foot.
entries.summary: With the bar over mid-foot and the shins brought to the bar, set the trunk, pull the slack out before the plates leave the floor, and push the floor away to stand tall with the bar close to the legs.

frames.caption: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, take a secure grip without rolling it away, bring the shins to the bar, and set the trunk.
Pull the slack out before the plates leave the floor, push the floor away, and stand tall with the bar close to the legs.
Stand tall with the bar close to the legs and the trunk braced.
Return the bar to the floor over mid-foot while keeping the bar close to the legs.
Pull the slack out first, push the floor away, and keep the bar close to the legs.

entries.name: Deficit Deadlift
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 24 degrees so it pairs directly with Deadlift while showing the low platform under the feet, the deeper knee and hip bend at the bottom, and the flat back: standing on a low platform with the bar on the floor over mid-foot, pulling the slack out before the bar breaks the floor, pulling through the longer bottom range to lockout, and returning the bar to the floor with a flat back.
entries.summary: Standing on a low platform one to three inches high with the bar over mid-foot and a flat back through the deeper knee and hip bend, pull the slack out before the bar breaks the floor and pull through the longer bottom range to lockout.

frames.caption: Stand on a low platform one to three inches high with the bar over mid-foot, brace with a flat back, and set up with the deeper knee and hip bend of the deficit.
Pull the slack out before the bar breaks the floor and pull to lockout through the longer bottom range.
Stand tall at lockout on the low platform with the bar close.
Return the bar to the floor while keeping a flat back through the extra range.
Earn the extra range with a flat back, pull the slack out before the bar breaks the floor, and keep the deficit small.

entries.name: Deadlift with Bands
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 24 degrees so the bands anchored under the feet and looped over the bar, the grip just outside the legs, the shins brought to the bar, and the flat back all read clearly: driving through the feet to lift the bar from the floor, bringing the hips forward as the bar passes the knees to stand tall against the band tension, and lowering by pushing the hips back and guiding the bar down the legs to the floor.
entries.summary: With bands looped over the bar and anchored under the feet, bring the shins to the bar with the chest up and the back flat, drive through the feet and bring the hips forward to stand tall against the band tension, then lower by pushing the hips back and guiding the bar down the legs to the floor.

frames.caption: Loop the bands over the bar and anchor them under the feet, stand with the bar over the middle of the feet, grip it just outside the legs, and bring the shins to the bar with the chest up and the back flat.
Drive through the feet to lift the bar, and as the bar passes the knees, bring the hips forward to stand tall against the band tension.
Stand tall into the bands with the bar against the legs.
Lower by pushing the hips back and guiding the bar down the legs to the floor.
Chest up, back flat, keep the bar against the legs, and stand tall into the bands.

entries.name: Reverse Band Deadlift
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 24 degrees so the power rack frame, the bands hanging from the top of the rack and looped around the bar, the hip-width stance, and the shoulder-width grip all read together: bringing the shins to the bar with the chest up and the back flat, driving through the feet and bringing the hips forward as the bar passes the knees to stand tall, and lowering by pushing the hips back and guiding the bar to the floor.
entries.summary: Inside a rack with bands hung from the top and looped around the bar, stand hip-width apart with the shins at the bar, the chest up, and the back flat, drive through the feet and bring the hips forward to stand tall, then lower by pushing the hips back and guiding the bar to the floor.

frames.caption: Inside a rack, hang bands from the top and loop them around the bar, stand with the bar over the middle of the feet hip-width apart, grip at shoulder width, and bring the shins to the bar with the chest up and the back flat.
Drive through the feet to lift the bar, and as the bar passes the knees, bring the hips forward to stand tall.
Stand tall inside the rack with the hips forward and the bar against the legs.
Lower by pushing the hips back and guiding the bar to the floor.
Chest up, back flat, keep the bar against the legs, and bring the hips forward to stand tall.

entries.name: Sumo Deadlift
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 46 degrees so the wide stance, the knees tracking out over the feet, the straight arms gripping the bar inside the knees, and the upright torso all show clearly: setting up with the plates on the floor over mid-foot, driving the floor away while keeping the bar against the legs to stand tall, and pushing the hips back and bending the knees to return the bar to the floor.
entries.summary: In a wide stance with the toes pointed out and the bar over mid-foot, grip the bar inside your knees with straight arms, brace with the chest up, and drive the floor away keeping the bar against your legs until you stand tall, then push your hips back and bend your knees to return the bar to the floor.

frames.caption: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out, and the bar over mid-foot, then grip the bar inside your knees with straight arms and the chest up.
Brace, then drive the floor away while pushing the floor apart with your feet, keeping the bar against your legs until you stand tall.
Stand tall with straight arms and the bar against your legs.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to return the bar to the floor.
Knees track over toes, chest up before you pull, and push the floor apart with your feet.

entries.name: Reverse Band Sumo Deadlift
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 46 degrees so the power rack frame, the bands hanging from the top of the rack and looped around the bar, the wide stance, and the straight arms gripping inside the legs all read clearly: lowering the hips with the chest up, driving through the floor and spreading it apart with the feet to bring the hips to the bar and stand tall, and lowering by pushing the hips back and controlling the bar to the floor.
entries.summary: Inside a rack with bands hung from the top and looped around the bar, set the feet wide with the bar over the middle of the feet and the arms inside the legs, lower the hips with the chest up, drive through the floor and bring the hips to the bar to stand tall, then push the hips back and control the bar to the floor.

frames.caption: Inside a rack, hang bands from the top and loop them around the bar, set the feet wide with the bar over the middle of the feet, grip with the arms inside the legs, and lower the hips with the chest up.
Drive through the floor while spreading it apart with the feet, and as the bar passes the knees, bring the hips to the bar and stand tall.
Stand tall with the hips at the bar and the arms straight.
Lower by pushing the hips back and controlling the bar to the floor.
Chest up, arms straight, push the knees out over the feet, and bring the hips to the bar to finish.

entries.name: Sumo Deadlift with Bands
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 46 degrees so the short bands anchored under the wide-set feet and looped over the bar, the knees pushed out over the feet, and the straight arms gripping inside the legs all read clearly: lowering the hips with the chest up, driving through the floor and spreading it apart with the feet to bring the hips to the bar and stand tall against the band tension, and lowering by pushing the hips back and controlling the bar to the floor.
entries.summary: With short bands looped over the bar and anchored under the wide-set feet, grip the bar with the arms inside the legs, lower the hips with the chest up, drive through the floor and bring the hips to the bar to stand tall against the band tension, then push the hips back and control the bar to the floor.

frames.caption: Loop short bands over the bar and stand on them with the feet set wide and the bar over the middle of the feet, grip the bar with the arms inside the legs, and lower the hips with the chest up.
Drive through the floor while spreading it apart with the feet, and as the bar passes the knees, bring the hips to the bar and stand tall against the band tension.
Stand tall against the band tension with the hips at the bar and the arms straight.
Lower by pushing the hips back and controlling the bar to the floor.
Chest up, arms straight, push the knees out over the feet, and bring the hips to the bar to finish.
